diagnostics.note: Expect.code names the shared Luau category. Expect.helper_codes explicitly maps immutable-file rejection paths; strict parser structure limits may report oversize on PowerShell. All mappings require rejection, never permit acceptance. Report-input schema-only cases do not claim helper publication authority. Typed record_ruling replies, including provisioned coordinator capability checks, run through actual POSIX/PowerShell reply consumers. Managed bridge cases are native-only and run through both packaged plugin codecs.
